questions.question: Which is greater, 3,09 or 3,1? Explain how you know.
questions.expected_answer: 3,1 is greater. Both numbers have 3 wholes, so compare the tenths: 3,1 has 1 tenth and 3,09 has 0 tenths. Writing 3,1 as 3,10 shows 310 hundredths against 309 hundredths.

questions.question: Order the swimming times 35,4 s, 34,98 s and 35,09 s from fastest to slowest.
questions.expected_answer: The fastest time is the smallest number. 34,98 s has only 34 wholes, so it is fastest. Next is 35,09 s, because 0 tenths is less than 4 tenths. Then 35,4 s. The order is 34,98 s; 35,09 s; 35,4 s.

questions.question: Round 3,68 to the nearest tenth and to the nearest whole number.
questions.expected_answer: To the nearest tenth, look at the hundredths digit, which is 8; that is 5 or more, so round up to 3,7. To the nearest whole number, look at the tenths digit, which is 6; that is 5 or more, so round up to 4.
